customManagers.description: Tool pins annotated `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name>` (setup action: actionlint, golangci-lint, govulncheck, hadolint; ci-chart.yml: helm). Any number of `#` lines may sit between the annotation and the `KEY: value` line. From jacaudi/stormglass#295.

Digest-pinned images outside Dockerfiles and manifests Renovate already parses: zimit, the kind node and nginx in the chart values, taskfile and test fixtures. Tag and digest move together. Dockerfile FROM digests are covered by the built-in dockerfile manager.

packageRules.description: Regenerate CRDs and sync to Helm chart after controller-tools updates
golangci-lint and govulncheck must lead every Go toolchain bump (newer toolchains emit export data older lint builds cannot read); one PR moves all three. Mirrors jacaudi/stormglass.
